Early Dismissal Changes the Dynamic The match began with high intensity, but the tactical plans of FC Midtjylland were thrown into disarray after just 15 minutes. A serious foul by Friday Etim left the referee with no choice but to brandish a red card , forcing the visitors to play with ten men for the vast majority of the game. This early exit prompted an immediate tactical adjustment, with Valdemar Byskov making way for Denil Castillo as the Danish side tried to shore up their defenses. Kokcu Breaks the Deadlock Capitalizing on the numerical advantage, Besiktas began to dictate the tempo. The pressure culminated in the 26th minute when Vaclav Cerny found Orkun Kokcu in a dangerous position. From well outside the box, Kokcu unleashed a powerful right-footed strike that flew past the goalkeeper, igniting celebrations across the stadium. The Turkish side continued to control the ball throughout the remainder of the first half , heading into the break with the momentum firmly on their side. Tactical Battle in the Second Half The second half saw a flurry of substitutions as both managers looked to influence the outcome. Besiktas introduced fresh legs in Milot Rashica and Semih Kilicsoy , while Midtjylland brought on Martin Erlic and Gue-Sung Cho to stay competitive. The clash between Besiktas and Trabzonspor brought the intensity of the Süper Lig to the forefront, as both giants sought to assert their dominance in one of Turkish football's most storied rivalries. Anticipation was high for a match that promised drama and high-octane action from the very first whistle. Early Firepower and Instant Impact The match on May 9, 2026 , began with an unexpected twist as Besiktas was forced into an early change. Just seven minutes in, Andre Onana had to leave the field, making way for Ahmet Dogan Yildirim . Despite the early disruption, the home side didn't take long to find their rhythm. In the 14th minute, Orkun Kokcu stepped up to the penalty spot and coolly dispatched his effort to give Besiktas the lead. The celebrations had barely died down when the lead was doubled just sixty seconds later. Mehmet Umut Nayir turned provider, setting up Oleksandr Zubkov , who found the back of the net to stun Trabzonspor with a rapid-fire double. Sealing the Result in the Second Half As the second half got underway, the intensity remained high, and the referee was kept busy. Hyun-Gyu Oh saw yellow early in the period as Trabzonspor tried to claw their way back into the contest. However, Besiktas remained clinical. In the 62nd minute, Oleksandr Zubkov turned from scorer to creator, delivering a precise pass for Ernest Muci . The forward made no mistake, firing home to further extend the advantage and effectively put the game out of reach. Muci would later pick up a yellow card himself before being substituted for Paul Onuachu as part of a tactical reshuffle. Final Exchanges and Tactical Changes With the clock ticking down, both managers turned to their benches to see out the game. Vaclav Cerny and Ernest Muci were among those withdrawn, while Jota Silva and Paul Onuachu entered the fray. The closing stages were marked by a flurry of substitutions for both sides, as Anthony Nwakaeme and Oleksandr Zubkov also made way. Despite a late yellow card for Ahmet Dogan Yildirim in the 90th minute, the result was never in doubt as the final whistle confirmed a comprehensive performance in this Süper Lig encounter.

The goal set the tone for the opening period, as Beşiktaş continued to monopolize possession and squeeze the Gazişehir Gaziantep midfield. The pressure told again in the 22nd minute when the referee pointed to the penalty spot. Kristjan Asllani , having already played a starring role in the opener, stepped up to take responsibility himself. With total composure, he struck the ball home to double the lead, leaving the hosts with a mountain to climb before the game had even reached the half-hour mark. As tensions rose, Drissa Camara received a yellow card in the 31st minute, reflecting the frustration beginning to boil over within the home ranks. Tactical Adjustments and Second-Half Grit Following the interval, the match transitioned into a more balanced but cagey affair. In the 66th minute, the hosts introduced Christopher Lungoyi and Denis Dragus in a bid to spark a comeback, while Beşiktaş responded by bringing on the steel of Wilfred Ndidi and the creativity of El Bilal Toure . The final stages of the match were defined by a flurry of substitutions as both sides rotated their squads. Despite five minutes of added time and late efforts from Gaziantep substitutes like Melih Kabasakal , the defensive resolve of the away side remained unbroken. The final whistle confirmed a professional performance from the Istanbul giants, who relied on their early clinical edge to secure a vital result on the road.

The Süper Lig clash between Çaykur Rizespor and Beşiktaş promised high-octane football , with both sides desperate to claim a vital result. On May 15, 2026, the two teams delivered a spectacle that showcased the classic "game of two halves" narrative, leaving fans breathless until the final whistle. Rizespor's Explosive First Half The match began with Çaykur Rizespor asserting their dominance early on. After an early caution for Emmanuel Agbadou , the home side broke the deadlock in the 18th minute. Modibo Sagnan turned provider for Ali Sowe , who finished clinically to ignite the home crowd. The momentum remained firmly with Rizespor, and in the 31st minute, Ali Sowe doubled his tally, clinical again following an assist from Adedire Awokoya Mebude . Beşiktaş struggled to find their rhythm in the face of such relentless pressure. Tactical discipline slipped as both Cengiz Under and Wilfred Ndidi received yellow cards before the break. Trailing by two goals at halftime, the visitors appeared to be facing a long and difficult road back into the contest. The Tactical Shift and Comeback The start of the second half saw a bold triple substitution from the Beşiktaş bench, introducing Jota Silva , Vaclav Cerny , and Junior Olaitan . This move paid dividends almost immediately. In the 55th minute, Orkun Kokcu delivered a precise pass to Jota Silva , who found the net to pull one back. The momentum shifted entirely, and by the 62nd minute, the scores were level. Vaclav Cerny struck the equalizer after being set up by fellow substitute Junior Olaitan . The final half-hour was a tense affair, characterized by tactical fouls and a flurry of substitutions as both managers looked to secure the win. Ali Sowe 's afternoon took a disciplinary turn with a yellow card in the 63rd minute, and Casper Hoejer Nielsen followed him into the book deep in stoppage time. Despite the late drama, the points were shared after 99 minutes of intense sports action, concluding a thrilling encounter in Rizespor.
